faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the SIDBI Market Intelligence and Research Analyst (MIRA) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 25th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated email address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Graduate degree in fields like Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Commerce, Finance, Data Science, Public Policy, or a related discipline from a recognized institution. A postgraduate qualification or relevant certifications are also preferred.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Market Intelligence and Research Analyst (MIRA) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for this position is 35 years. There is no minimum age specified in the provided data.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Market Intelligence and Research Analyst (MIRA) role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 20.00 lakh Per Annum. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates be selected for the Market Intelligence and Research Analyst (MIRA) post?
faq.answer: The selection process involves two main stages: shortlisting of applications followed by a personal interview. Candidates must perform well in both stages to be considered.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for the SIDBI MIRA recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via Email. Candidates need to prepare their application and send it to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. How many vacancies are available for the Market Intelligence and Research Analyst (MIRA) post?
faq.answer: There is only one vacancy available for the Market Intelligence and Research Analyst (MIRA) position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. What type of job is this recruitment?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job. The selected candidate will be appointed on a contract basis for the Market Intelligence and Research Analyst (MIRA) role.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location for this SIDBI recruitment?
faq.answer: The job location for this recruitment is Mumbai, Maharashtra.
